sqlMap.select: SELECT MESSAGEID, SIGNAL, REQUESTTIME, SENDCOMREGNO, AUTHTOKEN, SERVICECODE, SEARCHCOMREGNO, REPOTYPECODE FROM ( SELECT 'BiZoNSvCeTaxBillStatusAR' AS MESSAGEID ,'DTI_STATUS_LIST' AS SIGNAL , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS REQUESTTIME , A.SUP_COM_REGNO AS SENDCOMREGNO , MAX(NVL(C.AUTHTOKEN,'MUNmdHNMeWlwWGRyb0doeHZOdHIvb2JzTjBka1dVMUNxNUYxWlpTS1Jjdz0K')) AS AUTHTOKEN , 'DTI' AS SERVICECODE , '' AS SEARCHCOMREGNO , MAX(A.SUPBUY_TYPE) AS REPOTYPECODE FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN A, XXSB_DTI_STATUS B, XXSB_DTI_SM_USER C WHERE A.CONVERSATION_ID = B.CONVERSATION_ID AND A.SUPBUY_TYPE = 'AR' AND A.CREATED_BY = C.FND_USER(+) AND A.SUP_COM_REGNO = C.FND_REGNO(+) AND B.DTI_STATUS IN ('I','C','V','S','A','O','E') AND B.NTS_SEND_STATUS IN ('9','3','2','1','0') AND A.CREATION_DATE BETWEEN SYSDATE-20 AND SYSDATE GROUP BY A.SUPBUY_TYPE, A.SUP_COM_REGNO UNION ALL SELECT 'BiZoNSvCeTaxBillStatusAP' AS MESSAGEID ,'DTI_STATUS_LIST' AS SIGNAL , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS REQUESTTIME , A.BYR_COM_REGNO AS SENDCOMREGNO , MAX(NVL(C.AUTHTOKEN,'MUNmdHNMeWlwWGRyb0doeHZOdHIvb2JzTjBka1dVMUNxNUYxWlpTS1Jjdz0K')) AS AUTHTOKEN , 'DTI' AS SERVICECODE , '' AS SEARCHCOMREGNO , MAX(A.SUPBUY_TYPE) AS REPOTYPECODE FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN A, XXSB_DTI_STATUS B, XXSB_DTI_SM_USER C WHERE A.CONVERSATION_ID = B.CONVERSATION_ID AND A.SUPBUY_TYPE = 'AP' AND A.CREATED_BY = C.FND_USER(+) AND A.BYR_COM_REGNO = C.FND_REGNO(+) AND B.DTI_STATUS IN ('I','C','V','S','A','O','E') AND B.NTS_SEND_STATUS IN ('9','3','2','1','0') AND A.CREATION_DATE BETWEEN SYSDATE-20 AND SYSDATE GROUP BY A.SUPBUY_TYPE, A.BYR_COM_REGNO )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE XXSB_DTI_STATUS SET NTS_RESULT_CODE = #NTS_RESULT_CODE# , NTS_SEND_STATUS = #NTS_SEND_STATUS# , NTS_SEND_DATE = #NTS_SEND_DATE# , DTI_STATUS = #DTI_STATUS# , RETURN_CODE = DECODE(#DTI_STATUS#,'C','',RETURN_CODE) , RETURN_DESCRIPTION = DECODE(#DTI_STATUS#,'C','',RETURN_DESCRIPTION) , LAST_UPDATED_BY = 'BATCH' , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CONVERSATION_ID = #ETC_PCS_NO#
sqlMap.select: SELECT CNT, GUBUN, SEARCHFROMDATE, SEARCHTODATE, CASE WHEN GUBUN IN ('1', '2', '3') THEN 'Y' WHEN GUBUN = '4' AND MOD(CNT,2) = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN GUBUN = '5' AND MOD(CNT,2) = 1 THEN 'Y' WHEN GUBUN = '6' AND MOD(CNT,3) = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS RUN FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24') BETWEEN '07' AND '20' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FLAG, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MRO_JOB_DATE WHERE PGM_ID = #PGM_ID# AND JOB_SDATE > TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TO_CHAR(JOB_SDATE,'HH24') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24') ) AS CNT FROM DUAL ) A, (SELECT '1' AS GUBUN, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7 ,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHFROMDATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHTODATE FROM DUAL UNION SELECT '2' AS GUBUN, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-14,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHFROMDATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8 ,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHTODATE FROM DUAL UNION SELECT '3' AS GUBUN, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-21,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHFROMDATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-15,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHTODATE FROM DUAL UNION SELECT '4' AS GUBUN, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-28,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHFROMDATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-22,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHTODATE FROM DUAL UNION SELECT '5' AS GUBUN, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-35,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHFROMDATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-29,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHTODATE FROM DUAL UNION SELECT '6' AS GUBUN, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-42,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHFROMDATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-36,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEARCHTODATE FROM DUAL) B
